title: Why Buying Big Sizes and Refills Saves You Money
excerpt: The maths behind refilling, explained simply.
body:
Small bottles cost more per litre. When you buy a 5L or 25L jug and refill the bottles you already own, you pay for cleaner, not packaging.

## Pay less per litre

Compare the price per litre on each size. The bigger jugs usually work out cheapest.

## Less plastic in the bin

One 25L jerrycan replaces 25 one-litre bottles.
